title: Invite and create a member account
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Add owner invite management and member signup by code with server confirmation and optional unverified email. Scope each code to its server.

**Verify** · Verify success, username conflict, concurrent redemption, expiry, revocation and retry. The member gets one private Home and cannot see another member’s files.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-059, WI-061

**Queue** · Follows WI-064 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
